name: Mobavenue AI Tech Limited
about: Mobavenue AI Tech Limited operates AI-powered advertising, marketing, and consumer media platforms in India and internationally. It offers digital media and advertising agency services, including digital marketing, content creation, mobile advertising, promotional campaigns through various platforms, including mobile phones and connected devices. The company also provides customized computer applications, IT solutions, systems integration, technical consultancy, and software-related support services. In addition, it offers AmplifiX, an AI-enabled partner marketing platform; OrbitX, an AI-powered search and contextual advertising platform; PrsmX, an AI-powered brand awareness and omnichannel programmatic platform; SurgeX, an AI-powered programmatic scalable demand-side platform; ResurgeX, an AI-powered programmatic retargeting and remarketing platform; DiscvrX, a self-service AI-powered user-acquisition platform; and PiiX, an AI-powered growth intelligence platform purpose-built for Apple search ads. The company was formerly known as Lucent Industries Limited and changed its name to Mobavenue AI Tech Limited in October 2025. Mobavenue AI Tech Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
